question: By what means and in what mode is the supreme form to be resorted to at the beginning of this action?
premises: At first, by the south fire and by dissolution through the net of gentle kala, an action is prescribed.
That action is to resort to the supreme form.
It is to be done by becoming one with that form.
inference: Thus, at first, by the south fire and by dissolution through the net of gentle kala, one should resort to the supreme form by becoming one with it.
uncertainties: Identity of the south fire is technical and not defined by this verse alone.
Net of gentle kala remains open without reference to the fixed lists in this ahnika.
plain_english: Thus, at first, by the south fire and by dissolution through the net of gentle kala, one should resort to the supreme form by becoming one with it.
